title: Compatible Artin--Schreier exact rows with coherent Frobenius models
statement: Let k and k′ be algebraically closed fields of characteristic p, p prime, with a k-algebra structure on k′. Let f:C to Spec k be a smooth proper connected curve of dimension at most one [def-sc-curves, def-weil-proper-morphism], and let C′ be its displayed base change. There are a finite-dimensional k-module V, Frobenius-semilinear F on V and F′ on k′ tensor V with F′(1 tensor v)=1 tensor F(v), abelian etale sheaves G on C and G′ on C′ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and short exact rows 0 to constant Z/p to G via i to G via wp to 0 and 0 to inverse-image constant Z/p to G′ via i′ to G′ via wp′ to 0 [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence, def-sc-constant-sheaves]. Their H^0(wp) and H^0(wp′) maps are surjective. There are a sheaf map q:inverse-image G to G′ and additive equivalences b:H^1(G) to V and b′:H^1(G′) to k′ tensor V [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], such that (inverse-image i) followed by q equals i′, b carries H^1(wp) to F-1, b′ carries H^1(wp′) to F′-1, and b′(H^1(q)(pullback(x)))=1 tensor b(x) for all x in H^1(G). No degree-one constant-sheaf kernel equivalence is asserted.

proof.text: Construct G and G' explicitly as lifted tensor-section structure sheaves. Characteristic p on k maps to zero in global sections on C and then C'. Use the section-data theorem on both schemes and its separate exactness theorem to obtain wp, wp', i and i_0 with the required formulas and exactness.
Apply the specified-row pullback compatibility theorem to obtain q, i', its zero composite, short exactness, both sheaf squares, and the adjoint pullback section formula.
Apply additive scalar base change to obtain V, finite-dimensionality, b, b', scalar sheaf maps, and the canonical cohomology pullback formula.

The private proved helper exists_frobenius_model constructs phi=wp+id and checks its section formula phi(x)=x^p. Conjugate H^1(phi) by b to an additive map psi. For scalar sheaf maps mu_c and mu_(c^p), ring-map preservation of powers proves mu_c followed by phi equals phi followed by mu_(c^p). Cohomology functoriality and scalar compatibility make psi Frobenius-semilinear, giving F. Additivity gives the formula H^1(wp)=F-id. Apply the identical proved helper on C' using b' to obtain F'.

Functoriality of cohomology pullback and the wp-square give compatibility of H^1(wp) and H^1(wp'). For v=b(x), rewrite this equality using b', the two F-id formulas, and the canonical pullback formula. Distribute tensor over subtraction and cancel the common 1 tensor v term to obtain F'(1 tensor v)=1 tensor F(v). Surjectivity of b covers all v.

The private proved helper surjective_sheafH_zero uses smoothness to get regularity and reducedness. The existing global-sections bijectivity theorem for a proper connected reduced scheme over an algebraically closed field identifies global functions with k; the field Artin--Schreier map is onto. Evaluate at the terminal etale object and use the natural Sheaf.H.equiv_0 to prove H^0(wp) surjective directly in the Ext model. Smoothness and properness persist under the displayed pullback; connectedness over the algebraically closed field is geometric connectedness, so C' is connected. Repeat the same helper on C'. This also handles dimension zero.
Assemble V, F, F', the explicit sheaves, specified maps, additive equivalences, short exactness and degree-zero surjectivity into the unchanged existential conclusion.
